# Copied verbatim from hyphence docs/rfcs/0005-vectors.txt at commit 1c63a98bc70a (below this line).
# hyphence canonical-emission conformance vectors (RFC 0005, "Test Vectors").
#
# The shape is piggy docs/rfcs/0013-vectors.txt's, so piggy can replay these
# beside its own act vectors. Replayed by rust/hyphence/src/conformance.rs
# (emission_vectors) and go/hyphence/emission_vectors_test.go
# (TestEmissionVectors) from their byte-identical copies at
# rust/hyphence/testdata/0005-vectors.txt and
# go/hyphence/testdata/0005-vectors.txt; the flake's vectors-equality check
# fails when any of the three drifts.
#
# Records are separated by blank lines. Each line is "key: value", except
# that a document is written one line per "| " line (the text after "| " is
# the line, and a lone "|" is an empty line); every document line ends in
# LF. Keys:
#
#   name          record name
#   outcome       canonical | refuse
#   document      the input (as "| " lines)
#   body-hex      lowercase hex appended to "document" and, for a canonical
#                 record, to "canonical": body bytes a "| " line cannot
#                 carry. RFC 0005 never changes a body.
#   canonical     (canonical) the canonical form: the document decoded into
#                 a typed head and encoded under RFC 0005. Encoding the
#                 canonical form again MUST reproduce it.
#   rule          (refuse) why decoding refuses it: envelope (RFC 0001) |
#                 content (RFC 0002/0003 content grammar)
#
# These are hyphence's rules only. A consumer applies its own normalizations
# first (piggy RFC 0013 §3.1 drops comments, orders fields and treats an
# empty body as no body); hyphence keeps comments, keeps the caller's order
# within a rank, and keeps an empty body. The digests are markl test values
# (a 0x00, 0x01, ... payload), lexeme-valid and never decoded by hyphence.

name: canonical/already-canonical-is-a-fixed-point
outcome: canonical
document:
| ---
| # a description
| - kind = approval
| - key = piggy-piv_sig-v1@blake2b256-qqqsyqcyq5rqwzqfpg9scrgwpugpzysnzs23v9ccrydpk8qarc0s6vk400
| - prev = @sha256-qqqsyqcyq5rqwzqfpg9scrgwpugpzysnzs23v9ccrydpk8qarc0s7lcgm6
| - urgent
| - one/uno@blake2b256-qqqsyqcyq5rqwzqfpg9scrgwpugpzysnzs23v9ccrydpk8qarc0s6vk400
| ! piggy-act-v1
| ---
canonical:
| ---
| # a description
| - kind = approval
| - key = piggy-piv_sig-v1@blake2b256-qqqsyqcyq5rqwzqfpg9scrgwpugpzysnzs23v9ccrydpk8qarc0s6vk400
| - prev = @sha256-qqqsyqcyq5rqwzqfpg9scrgwpugpzysnzs23v9ccrydpk8qarc0s7lcgm6
| - urgent
| - one/uno@blake2b256-qqqsyqcyq5rqwzqfpg9scrgwpugpzysnzs23v9ccrydpk8qarc0s6vk400
| ! piggy-act-v1
| ---

name: canonical/rank-order-is-stable
outcome: canonical
document:
| ---
| ! md
| - b = 2
| @ blake2b256-qqqsyqcyq5rqwzqfpg9scrgwpugpzysnzs23v9ccrydpk8qarc0s6vk400
| - a = 1
| # a description
| ---
canonical:
| ---
| # a description
| - b = 2
| - a = 1
| @ blake2b256-qqqsyqcyq5rqwzqfpg9scrgwpugpzysnzs23v9ccrydpk8qarc0s6vk400
| ! md
| ---

name: canonical/spacing-and-angle-prefix
outcome: canonical
document:
| ---
| - kind=approval
| < blocks=one/uno@blake2b256-qqqsyqcyq5rqwzqfpg9scrgwpugpzysnzs23v9ccrydpk8qarc0s6vk400
| < urgent
| ! md
| ---
canonical:
| ---
| - kind = approval
| - blocks = one/uno@blake2b256-qqqsyqcyq5rqwzqfpg9scrgwpugpzysnzs23v9ccrydpk8qarc0s6vk400
| - urgent
| ! md
| ---

name: canonical/text-bare-only-when-ident
outcome: canonical
document:
| ---
| - a = "open"
| - b = 'open'
| - c = "spinclass:merge"
| - d = "2026-11-08T23:00:00Z"
| - e = "-"
| - f = "two words"
| - g = "ends-in-colon:"
| - h = ""
| - i = 'say "hi"'
| ! md
| ---
canonical:
| ---
| - a = open
| - b = open
| - c = spinclass:merge
| - d = 2026-11-08T23:00:00Z
| - e = -
| - f = "two words"
| - g = "ends-in-colon:"
| - h = ""
| - i = "say \"hi\""
| ! md
| ---

name: canonical/field-name-bare-only-when-ident
outcome: canonical
document:
| ---
| - "plain" = v
| - "odd name" = v
| - "ends-in-colon:" = v
| ! md
| ---
canonical:
| ---
| - plain = v
| - "odd name" = v
| - "ends-in-colon:" = v
| ! md
| ---

name: canonical/quote-purpose-escape-set
outcome: canonical
document:
| ---
| - all = "\a\b\f\v\r\t\n\\\""
| - unknown = "x\qy"
| - single = 'tab\there'
| ! md
| ---
canonical:
| ---
| - all = "\a\b\f\v\r\t\n\\\""
| - unknown = xqy
| - single = "tab\there"
| ! md
| ---

name: canonical/comments-kept
outcome: canonical
document:
| ---
| ! md%type note
| % lead
| - k=v%glued
| # d
| % tail
| ---
canonical:
| ---
| # d
| % lead
| - k = v %glued
| ! md %type note
| % tail
| ---

| ! md

| ! md
| ---

| ! md
